text: あいてから　うける　じぶんへの　こうか　◎みず　くさ　かくとう　じめん　はがね　△ノーマル　ほのお　どく　ひこう

structure.jp: あいてから　うける　じぶんへの　こうか
structure.en: effect on yourself received from the opponent

structure.jp: ◎みず　くさ　かくとう　じめん　はがね
structure.en: super effective: Water, Grass, Fighting, Ground, Steel

structure.jp: △ノーマル　ほのお　どく　ひこう
structure.en: not very effective: Normal, Fire, Poison, Flying

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: あいてから　うける　じぶんへの　こうか
patterns.explanation: あいてから　うける sits in front of こうか and tells you which effect: the one you take from the opponent. あいてから　うける　じぶんへの　こうか = 'the effect on yourself received from the opponent'.

patterns.name: 〜への
patterns.explanation: へ means 'toward', and の ties that to the next thing, so it is an effect aimed at someone. じぶんへの　こうか = 'the effect on yourself'.
